text: Rokeby Manor in Landour is an unforgettable heritage retreat. The tea garden and pine valley vistas are divine. Emily's bakehouse serves the best apple pie in the hills.
Charming stone cottage ambiance and roaring wood fireplace kept us warm. Narrow Landour road has heavy traffic during weekends, but peaceful once you reach.
Emily's restaurant breakfast was sumptuous with fresh mountain preserves. Front desk staff courteous and organized our Lal Tibba sunset walk.
Beautiful heritage suite with vintage fittings, but water pressure in antique shower was a bit weak in the morning.
Outdoor jacuzzi overlooking the snow peaks is worth every penny. Pure bliss away from the noise of Mussoorie Mall Road.
Staff bhaiya bohot polite aur attentive the. Garam chai on the deck as autumn mist rolled through the deodars was magical.
Road climb up to Landour clock tower was steep and taxi charged ₹600 extra, but hotel hospitality made up for it.
Winter wonderland experience with roaring fireplace and mulled wine. Central heating in the stone rooms was flawless.
Peaceful Landour cantonment location. Room linen was crisp and pristine. Continental breakfast spread top notch.
Colonial charm preserved with meticulous care. Staff arranged seamless pickup from Dehradun airport.
